locations.name: Euro Ink 4 Less

exterior.description: Down a narrow alley off Astronomical Cock-Up Square, past a dumpster and between a 24-hour kebab shop and a suspicious currency exchange. Pink neon spills onto cracked concrete, the sign reading 'EURO INK 4 LESS' with the '4' flickering uncertainly. Hand-painted secondary signs promise 'WALK-INS WELCOME' and 'NO REGRETS' (with smaller text 'Mostly' visible on close inspection). Window stickers boast 'HYGENIC' (misspelled) and a license expired in 2019. The occasional scream from inside could be pain or could be the radio.
exterior.entry_condition: Must trigger 'tattoo_decision_made' state at Astronomical Cock-Up Square. Tattoo Barker encounter required.

interior.theme: Budget tattoo parlor where artistic vision exceeds artistic ability, and both artist and customer exist in mutual delusion

functions: Lord Pilsner's duck tattoo acquisition (permanent cosmetic)
Hold Still mini-game during tattooing process
Jakub NPC origin - recurring in other cities
Shop for additional tattoo services post-quest
Comedy set-piece: skeleton becomes duck through 'artistic interpretation'
Unlocks 'Lord Pilsner Special' menu item for return visits

tattoo_station_jakub_primary_workspace.description: Duct-taped adjustable chair, rolling cart of equipment, harsh spotlight. This is where skeletons become ducks.

mini_game_hold_still_tattoo.description: Player must tap at the right moments to prevent Lord Pilsner from flinching during the tattooing process.

event_hook_tattoo_reveal.key_moment: Its clearly a duck. Lord Pilsner sees it backwards in mirror, loves it.
event_hook_tattoo_reveal.dialogue_highlight: It's ARTISTIC INTERPRETATION. Europeans do things different.

flash_art_wall_suspiciously_many_birds.easter_egg: After examining 3 times, player notices all Jakub's 'skull' designs have beaks
flash_art_wall_suspiciously_many_birds.description: Walls covered in tattoo flash art. 90% skulls, flames, tribal, and Looney Tunes. A suspicious number of bird-like shapes in the 'skull' section.

selfie_prop_fresh_duck_tattoo_mirror.screenshot_moment: Lord Pilsner proudly showing duck tattoo in mirror, thinking its a skeleton

hidden_area_back_room_mattress_visible.description: Jakub's living quarters. Mattress on floor, personal items visible. He lives here.
hidden_area_back_room_mattress_visible.player_implication: This explains the dedication to his craft.

marta_presence.dialogue_contribution: Provides Czech-language asides and skeptical reactions

post_credits_reference.punchline: The tattoo artist now offers 'the Lord Pilsner Special' - €50 for any duck-related design.
